about.text: A summer alpine-pasture cheese of the Valle del Lys in Valle d'Aosta, made from raw milk from the evening and morning milkings. The milk is heated to 35 °C, set with liquid calf rennet, put in wooden moulds and usually salted dry. It has a washed, smooth rind and is often sold fresh now, though ideal ageing is said to be up to about 1.5 years.

sources.text: Raw milk, alpine summer-only production, heating and calf rennet, rind, ageing and the Valle del Lys origin.
